st1_multi_s_a.description: 3 S_A providers + 1 S_Q. Cost vs latency tradeoff within S_A tier. Tests whether the joint router picks the right S_A under cross-tier constraints.
st1_multi_s_a.name: st1_multi_s_a

st2_s_q_degradation.description: S_Q starts fast (P50=200ms) then suddenly degrades to P50=2000ms at t=1800s. Tests whether the joint router stops using S_Q once it becomes unsafe.
st2_s_q_degradation.name: st2_s_q_degradation

st3_multi_day_rollover.description: 3-day simulation with S_Q quota=100 resetting every 24 h. Tests that psi(z) re-initializes at each window boundary and the joint router uses fresh capacity without hysteresis.
st3_multi_day_rollover.name: st3_multi_day_rollover
